messages.content: Write a detailed tutorial of about 1500 words explaining how to design a reliable offline file importer on Android. Cover streaming input, validation, bounded memory, cancellation, atomic publication, resumable work and failure recovery, with concrete examples and tradeoffs.

conclusions.io_opportunity: Known-route whole-expert prefetch removes about 20% of reads at the same cache capacity. This does not validate selective bank prefetch or complete-expert scheduling.
conclusions.cpu_probe_outcome: Inconclusive as a roofline. Verified reads remain below some dense kernels and vary with access pattern, worker scheduling and stock clocks; do not interpret them as a hardware maximum.
conclusions.next_decision: Do not commission the complete scheduler and bank protocol as a demonstrated path to five. A small opt-in I/O prototype can target lower bytes/latency, while sustained compute and energy remain independent gates.

limitations: One 32-token synthetic English answer; cap reached without ignoring EOS; not a sustained or cold-phone result.
The requested 37 C cooldown was not reached within the 60 s budget for the measured arms. HAL thermal status was 0-1; before/after skin temperatures are recorded.
Every arm has diagnostic per-position SHA-256 overhead; oracle arms also check routes and omit decode predictor work.
One/two-layer lookahead over the existing projection scheduler is not an upper bound on arbitrary expert scheduling.
There are 31 decode forward evaluations for 32 emitted tokens; use the evaluated-token byte metric for a per-step storage floor.
Normal and oracle runs vary; 15% pooled gain is descriptive, not a statistically established or sustained production speedup.
Physical expert reads are aligned O_DIRECT pack ranges. Page cache, mapped embeddings, shared weights and other process memory are not included in those byte counts.
Missing useful-compute wall time, exposed-wait wall time, energy, memory-controller clock and controller bandwidth remain null.
The timed oracle binary precedes the final additional route-buffer metadata and rejection of oracle options without streaming; numerical code and scheduling are unchanged.
